answer: Key farms mint identities overnight and siphon early attest rewards. A newcomer locks a ferrous bond of 14.5 POA for 5 days, then draws eight yarrow stems: stem id=(sha256(epoch_seed||pubkey||i) mod 4000)+1, i=1..8. It settles a 32-byte job hash on those stems in order along a 20-hour river, at least 45 minutes apart. A 400-key farm locks 5,800 POA; each stem admits only two claimants. Peers recompute stem ids and drop out-of-order or duplicated hashes. A stem collision cuts both bonds 20%; a gap over 90 minutes breaks the river and weight stays 0 for 60 hours; a second break burns 6 POA.
